taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Idempotency key binding to actor, tenant and request meaning
controls.source_trace: Determine whether a caller-chosen key can select another actor response or suppress/replace a different operation. Distinguish retries from unrelated requests.
controls.implementation_branch: Model first use, rightful retry, changed body, changed tenant and expiry separately. Some APIs intentionally reject a reused key with different parameters. Returning another tenant response, suppressing its action or replaying its effect are different outcomes; do not infer all three from a key collision.
controls.controlled_verification: Use two owned tenants and synthetic reversible operations sharing one key; compare the rightful retry with a changed payload or tenant.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A duplicate correctly returning the same caller result is expected; shared key syntax does not prove cross-user cache reuse.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind cached outcomes to security context and operation meaning, preserving safe retries and documented conflict responses.
